title: Introducing TrGLUE and SentiTurca: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Turkish General Language Understanding and Sentiment Analysis
reasoning: The paper includes 'Religion' and 'Sects' as specific target categories within the Turkish Hate Map dataset of the SentiTurca benchmark. It explicitly evaluates how models identify hate speech and offensive content related to religious groups and sectarian divides (such as the Alevi community) in Turkey.
